title: Discrete State-Space
text: Implement discrete state-space system, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {A} sets Matrix coefficient A; {B}, {C}, {D}, {Initial conditions} sets the initial state, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {State name} sets the unique name for block state and {State name must resolve to Simulink signal object} requires state name resolve to a signal. Values come from the instance.

params.name: A
params.values: Matrix coefficient A 1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: B
params.values: Matrix coefficient B 1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: C
params.values: Matrix coefficient, C 1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: D
params.values: Matrix coefficient, D 1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: State name
params.values: Unique name for block state ’’ (default) | alphanumeric string

params.name: State name must resolve to Simulink signal object
params.values: Require state name resolve to a signal object off (default) | on
